create_xlm_config: create an XLMConfig instance with default transformer model settings
init_model_from_xlm_config: initialize an XLMModel with random weights from an XLMConfig instance
access_model_config: access the XLMConfig from an initialized XLMModel via model.config
configure_multilingual_xlm: configure XLMConfig with n_langs greater than 1 for multilingual transformer models
customize_xlm_attention: customize XLMConfig with causal, sinusoidal_embeddings, and asm options for transformer attention
